findings.location: items/thm-csm-examples-flow-fine-entropy.md, Statement (the jointly C^2 family and C^1 velocity-field hypothesis); Proof step 1.1 and Facts F1
findings.evidence: The Statement does not relate b to chi_t, while Proof 1.1 applies the Jacobian lemma, whose Euclidean statement requires partial_t chi(t,a)=b(t,chi(t,a)). Under the written hypotheses take T=R/(2 pi Z) with normalized angle measure, I=(-1,1), chi_t([theta])=[theta+t sin(theta)], and b=0. For |t|<1, chi_t is a smooth diffeomorphism, chi_0=id, and div b=0. With f_0([theta])=1+eta cos(theta), 0<eta<1, the claimed f_t=f_0 composed with chi_t inverse has integral 1+eta t/2, not 1, when t is nonzero. Thus the stated probability-density conclusion is false. State the velocity relation in local translation charts and apply the periodic Jacobian result with that relation, or assume measure preservation directly.
